articles.title: Unable to take care of mother, 67-year-old man strangles her to death in Kolkata
articles.description: Sagar Ghosh, a 67-year-old engineer, reportedly strangled his 85-year-old mother, Uma Rani Ghosh, at home. He had been unemployed since the Covid pandemic and struggled to afford her care. Ghosh called the police himself to confess the crime after committing it. His sister was out during the incident and found their mother murdered upon returning. Police are investigating the situation and examining the motive behind this tragic event.

articles.title: Scotland’s beaver territories more than double since 2018
articles.description: Recent findings from a comprehensive survey highlight a notable expansion of beaver territories in Tayside and the Forth regions, now totaling an estimated 405 as of 2026. The survey spanned more than 2,397 km of waterways and documented abundant beaver signs, showcasing their transition from agricultural areas to new habitats. There are ongoing efforts to support land managers in learning to live harmoniously with these wildlife populations.

articles.title: A safe with $55,737 lay hidden in Maine woods for four years; now the mystery cash will help families stay warm this winter
articles.description: A surprising find in Falmouth, Maine—$55,737 found in a safe behind the fire station—remains unclaimed. After a lengthy four-year wait for an owner, the town council has chosen to donate this money to the local LIHEAP program. This initiative promises warmth this winter, benefitting approximately 50 families as they face increasing heating costs, highlighting the community's commitment to support those in need.
